description:
Grant items to a wallet (a reward, a make-good, a server-side award). Items are off-chain and non-transferable. Store key scope: entitlements:write.

Params: store_id, wallet, sku, quantity, reason?, session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, entitlement: Entitlement}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_400, HTTP_404 (unknown sku)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_grant
title: Grant items
